attchmntText: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Shri Sekar Balasubramanian as General Manager (Materials Management) of the company w.e.f. November 16, 2026. For more details kindly refer attached file.
voiceSummary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has disclosed the resignation of Shri Sekar Balasubramanian, General Manager (Materials Management), under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The resignation was submitted on 1 November 2026 due to health conditions. The company relieved him effective 02.11.2026. The internal no due process was completed on 16.11.2026. The resignation letter is attached as Annexure-1. Detailed information regarding the change in senior management personnel is provided in Annexure-2. The company requests the exchanges to take the information on record.

attchmntText: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates. we would like to inform you that the Company has paid consideration of Rs. 26,000/- towards acquisition of 26% equity share capital (i.e. 2,600 equity shares of Rs. 10 each) of FPEL Bhanu Private Limited ("SPV Company") today i.e. on 13.11.2026.
voiceSummary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited paid Rs. 26,000 on 13th November, 2026, to acquire 2,600 equity shares representing 26% stake in FPEL Bhanu Private Limited. The target entity is a special purpose vehicle for setting up a captive Wind-Solar Hybrid power project in Gujarat with a wind capacity of 19.8 MW and solar capacity of approximately 25 MWp. The company will subscribe to further capital to maintain the 26% equity holding. The acquisition is for renewable energy for captive use. The SPV was incorporated on 21st November, 2025, and has no turnover as it has not commenced operations. No governmental approvals are required. The transaction is not a related party transaction.

attchmntText: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates. We would like to inform you that the Company has executed Share Purchase Agreement and Shareholders' Agreement among Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL), Fourth Partner Energy Private Limited and Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) Company i.e. FPEL Bhanu Private Limited for setting up of a captive Wind-Solar Hybrid power project ( Project ) having a wind capacity of 19.8 MW & solar capacity of approximately 25 MWp (19.25 MW (AC)) in Gujarat.
voiceSummary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited executed agreements with Fourth Partner Energy Private Limited and its subsidiary FPEL Bhanu Private Limited for a captive Wind-Solar Hybrid power project in Gujarat. The project has a wind capacity of 19.8 MW and solar capacity of approximately 25 MWp. GACL will acquire a 26% stake in the SPV at face value, with Fourth Partner Energy holding 74%. Consideration is in cash. The SPV was incorporated on 21st November, 2025, with an authorized share capital of Rs. 15,00,000 and paid-up capital of Rs. 1,00,000. The transaction is not a related party deal. All power generated will be used by GACL for captive purposes. Regulatory approvals are not applicable. Completion is expected shortly.
